title: OroTitan Equity Research V1 Core Compatibility Schema for V2.0.5
description: V2.0.5 compatibility validation copy of the frozen V1 core. It preserves the V2.0.2 roic_trend NOT_APPLICABLE correction, the V2.0.3 ROIIC NOT_INTERPRETABLE correction, and the V2.0.4 STANDARD_ROIC NOT_INTERPRETABLE correction, and additionally corrects the ROIC_TREND representability defect by admitting UNKNOWN only for fundamental_states.roic_trend. It does not replace or rewrite the frozen V1 authority.

historical_snapshots.description: Append-only prior snapshots. Never overwritten by current data.

current_market_price.description: Live/refreshable market price, distinct from each snapshot's immutable RESEARCH_REFERENCE_PRICE.

activation_events.description: Market-price events only. An event is not a certified research snapshot.

numericRange.description: Inclusive analytical range. min <= max is enforced by the contract validator because JSON Schema cannot compare sibling numeric values portably.

dimensionScoreValue.description: Stored dimension judgment. Numeric judgments preserve the frozen 5-point increment discipline.

returnValue.x-unit: percentage points per annum; 12.0 means 12% p.a.

priceValue.x-unit: price per security in the associated currency

issuer_id.description: Economic issuer identity. One active candidate per issuer.

listing_status.description: Authoritative listing state from issuer/security normalization; no new methodological enum introduced here.

l1Identity.description: L1 IDENTITY. Issuer and security remain distinct. Multiple securities may map to one issuer.

data_cutoff.description: PIT boundary. Mandatory for every snapshot, including history.

reference_price.description: Immutable research reference price for this snapshot.

roic_trend.description: V2.0.5 compatibility: preserves the exact ROIC_TREND UNKNOWN analytical judgment without coercion. UNKNOWN remains distinct from UNCLEAR and NOT_APPLICABLE.

standard_roic.description: V2.0.4 compatibility: preserves the frozen STANDARD_ROIC analytical output NOT_INTERPRETABLE without broadening returnValue or global specialState semantics.

roiic.description: V2.0.3 compatibility: preserves the frozen ROIIC analytical output NOT_INTERPRETABLE without broadening returnValue or global specialState semantics.

x-orotitan-null-semantics.policy: Semantic nulls are not encoded as 0 or empty string. V1 uses explicit state tokens where a value can be unavailable or methodologically inapplicable.
x-orotitan-null-semantics.json_null: Not used for canonical semantic fields in V1; optional whole objects are omitted rather than set to null.

x-orotitan-deterministic-rules.OROTITAN_STATUS: YES iff full certification and every Elite gate passes and MATERIAL_WEAK_LINK_GATE passes (meaning MATERIAL_WEAK_LINK = NO)
x-orotitan-deterministic-rules.POTENTIAL_OROTITAN_MAX_PRICE: min(P_ER, P_NO_EXPANSION, P_MOS, P_IMPLIED) when all non-valuation OroTitan gates pass and valuation reliability is HIGH

x-orotitan-server-recomputation-policy: Deterministic formulas must have one canonical server-side implementation semantically identical to the frozen Master Prompt. Frontends may display results but must not implement divergent scoring logic.
